A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 3D Convex Splatting paper, with all 13 pages and supplementary Sections 5–8. Complete text extraction and rendered-page comparison support comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic reconstruction experiments, real-world novel-view synthesis results, and ablations, including supplementary results in Tables 4–10.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their numerical and qualitative outcomes in the main text and supplement.

M1.justification: Sections 2 and 6 retain the same convex representation, projection, rasterization, optimization loss, and adaptive densification procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic shapes and the same scenes from Mip-NeRF360, Tanks and Temples, and Deep Blending, including supplementary coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical: Mip-NeRF360, 3DGS, GES, and 2DGS in Tables 1–2, and 3DGS, 2DGS, and GES in supplementary Tables 5–10.

E3.justification: The experimental settings in Section 3.2 and supplementary Section 5 are identical, including metrics, model variants, numerical precision, and initialization and densification schedules.

E4.justification: The densification, points-per-convex, primitive-budget, and geometric-representation analyses in Section 3.4 are unchanged. Supplementary Section 7 retains the same perspective-scaling ablation.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports identical 3DCS PSNR values of 23.95, 29.81, and 27.29 for Tanks and Temples, Deep Blending, and Mip-NeRF360, respectively.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(8), including the supplementary 2D formulation, are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, rendering-quality, efficiency, and geometric-representation claims.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations of indoor versus outdoor performance, limitations on unstructured natural scenes, PSNR versus perceived quality, and training-speed and memory tradeoffs.

D1.justification: The printed project-page address changes from www.convexsplatting.com to convexsplatting.github.io, updating the documented resource access route. Implementation and hyperparameter details are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether resource contents or availability changed.

R1.justification: The same 56 references and related-work discussion remain, with identical positioning relative to NeRF, Gaussian splatting, and prior convex representations.

P1.justification: Only the project-page address and arXiv version/date stamp change. The prose, terminology, section order, and supplementary structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All 13 figures, 10 tables, captions, and page layouts are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–13 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the project-page address and arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical support, explanations, and visual presentation remain identical, including the supplement. Updating the project-page address and arXiv stamp does not establish a meaningful quality gain or loss; the PDFs provide no evidence of improved resource availability.
